notes.subject: long bilong ol man i go aut
notes.rationale: גורל em i ston smol ol i usim skelim, olsem lot — Tok Pisin i no gat wanpela tok stret bilong en

notes.subject: not
notes.rationale: Hebru יצא (i go aut) i tok long long, Tok Pisin i nidim samting long ai bilong makim wanpela long i go aut

notes.subject: lot/long
notes.rationale: Vers em i tingim long bilong graun namba fo — pasin bilong kaunim ol tumas graun

translation: Long Yisasakar i go aut ⟨⟨את⟩⟩ not: long bilong ol man i go aut — fofa bilong bilong Yisasakar, olgeta long ol klan bilong ol.

tokens.gloss: long bilong ol man i go aut
olgeta long ol klan bilong ol
